items.claim: CFO 給九月季總營收年增 9%–11%。
items.quote: company revenue to grow between 9% and 11% year-over-year.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給九月季 iPhone 年增中十位數。
items.quote: reported growth rate for iPhone to be mid-teens year-over-year.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說九月季 Services 成長率與六月季大致相近（已扣除約 2.5 個百分點匯率逆風的口徑）。
items.quote: reported growth rate to be largely similar to what we
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 給九月季毛利率 47%–48%。
items.quote: We expect gross margin to be between 47% and 48%.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 九月季毛利率指引含約 1 個百分點關稅退款效益。
items.quote: approximately 1 percentage point related to tariff refunds.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 九月季營業費用指引區間。
items.quote: $19.1 billion and $19.4 billion.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 表示九月季以後不提供財測或色彩。
items.quote: providing any kind of color or guidance beyond the September quarter.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 財測前提：關稅政策維持現況、總經不惡化。
items.quote: global tariff rates, policies, and their application remain in effect
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 預期九月季總營收受匯率逆風影響（口徑：對年增率的連續季拖累）。
items.quote: sequential headwind of about 2.5 percentage points
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 預期九月季供給限制明顯加重。
items.quote: impact from supply constraints to increase significantly sequentially.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說供給限制主因是 SoC 先進製程節點的可得性。
items.quote: primarily driven by the availability of the advanced
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 定性供給問題的根因，並說本季供給端要趕工。
items.quote: the root cause of it is not a regular supply issue.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 描述下一季供給端的處境。
items.quote: we're going to be scrambling on the supply side essentially.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 六月季公司毛利率 50.1%，含關稅退款約 2 個百分點；扣除後落在上季指引中點。
items.quote: favorable impact of approximately 2 percentage points.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 產品毛利率 40.1%（含關稅退款逾 2.5 個百分點）。
items.quote: Products gross margin was 40.1%, up 140 basis points sequentially.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 拆解毛利率連續季下滑：記憶體成本占主要，匯率影響小。
items.quote: I think that FX was a pretty minimal impact
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 說九月季記憶體採購成本再升。
items.quote: For September, we expect to pay even higher memory costs
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說九月以後記憶體市價續漲，對公司影響可能加大。
items.quote: continuing to increase, which could drive an increasing impact on our business
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說明 iPad／Mac 調價的原因。
items.quote: a 100-year flood on the memory pricing
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說定價不採單一公式，看長期而非 90 天。
items.quote: think about it over the long term instead of a 90-day clock.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 提到 DRAM 只有三家供應商，正評估所有選項。
items.quote: primarily the DRAM market has 3 suppliers
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 六月季回購與股利金額。
items.quote: $4 billion in dividends and equivalents and $25.8 billion
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 期末現金與有價證券。
items.quote: $147 billion in cash and marketable securities
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 董事會宣布每股 $0.27 股利。
items.quote: cash dividend of $0.27 per share of common stock
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 重申對美國 6,000 億美元投資承諾。
items.quote: we made a $600 billion commitment to the U.S. over 4
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說將把收到的關稅退款再投入美國。
items.quote: reinvest the tariff refunds we've received into the U.S.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: Broadcom 多年協議，預期金額超過 300 億美元。
items.quote: American Manufacturing program is expected to exceed $30
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 稱此為最大的美國製造承諾。
items.quote: our largest ever American manufacturing program commitment
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 休士頓廠今年稍晚開始生產 Mac mini。
items.quote: make Mac mini there, too.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 宣布這是最後一次法說，由 John Ternus 接手主持。
items.quote: this will be my final earnings call, and John will lead these calls going forward.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說 Arizona 晶圓廠今年供應的元件數量。
items.quote: we do source over 100 million components this
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 對 Siri AI 公測回饋的描述。
items.quote: we are off the charts excited about Siri AI.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: Siri AI 運算成本回收方式：iCloud+ 升級方案，但尚無完整計畫。
items.quote: we will have some kind of upgrade possibilities on iCloud+
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說 Siri AI 在歐盟尚無法同步推出，仍與歐盟執委會協商。
items.quote: we're working closely with them to try to get to something
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: 中國方面僅取得原始 Apple Intelligence 功能的出貨核准，Siri AI 後續仍需工作。
items.quote: approval to ship sort of the original features of Apple
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 提到 MacBook Neo 需求強、仍在努力補足供給。
items.quote: we're continuing to work hard to meet demand
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 談端側 AI 的策略地位。
items.quote: strategic and sort of a competitive weapon, if you will.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: Ternus 被問競爭格局（OpenAI 裝置、SpaceX AI 手機）時的回答。
items.quote: we're just really focused on our plans and very excited about it.
items.speaker: John Ternus

items.claim: CFO 說近一季美國教育機構 MacBook Neo 大單約半數取代 Windows／Chromebook。
items.quote: about half of the MacBook Neo large purchases
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 付費訂閱數里程碑。
items.quote: 1.5 billion in paid subscriptions.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 對 iPhone 是否有拉貨的回答：資料上看不出來。
items.quote: it's not obvious in the data that what you're asking is true.
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CEO 說 iPad／Mac 漲價後的價格彈性尚無定論。
items.quote: it's just too early to come to a definitive
items.speaker: CEO

items.claim: CFO 說 App Store 受手遊疲弱影響，六月季略遜預期。
items.quote: more softness on mobile gaming in the App Store.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 提到美國仍受法院對外部連結交易的裁決約束。
items.quote: we do continue to operate under a court ruling
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 說最高法院將審理其上訴。
items.quote: we're pleased that the Supreme Court will hear our appeal.
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CFO 拆解 Services 匯率逆風：自三月季到九月季約 5 個百分點。
items.quote: foreign exchange to drive about a 5 percentage point headwind
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: 營業費用年增 23%，主因研發投資。
items.quote: up 23% year-over-year, driven by investments in R&D
items.speaker: CFO

items.claim: CEO 回答 Siri AI 對資本密集度的影響：成本與 iCloud 升級的平衡尚不確定。
items.quote: what the balance of that is a bit uncertain at the moment.
items.speaker: CEO

qa_flags.question: Reitzes 追問 12 月季供給限制影響與可否給指引
qa_flags.response_pattern: CFO 明說九月季以後不提供任何色彩或指引，未回應 12 月季的數字

qa_flags.question: Wamsi Mohan 問 Ternus 競爭格局是否改變（OpenAI 裝置、SpaceX AI 手機）
qa_flags.response_pattern: Ternus 未談競爭對手，只說機會很多、專注自己的計畫

qa_flags.question: Wamsi Mohan 問 Siri AI 是否改變資本密集度
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 答混合模式、成本與 iCloud 升級的平衡尚不確定，未給數字

qa_flags.question: Michael Ng 問 Siri AI 運算成本與 iCloud+ 回收
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 稱還早、沒有完整計畫，只說會有 iCloud+ 升級選項

qa_flags.question: Reitzes 問是否可能拓寬矽晶圓供應商（含 Arizona 新晶圓廠）
qa_flags.response_pattern: CEO 改談需求超預期並稱非供應商問題，未回答是否擴大供應商
